item.title: Joy of Four-Star General Was Brief... Strained Relationship with Van Fleet's Successor (4성장군 기쁨도 잠시...밴 플리트 후임자와 껄끄러웠다)
item.description:
Joy of Four-Star General Was Brief... Strained Relationship with Van Fleet's Successor (4성장군 기쁨도 잠시...밴 플리트 후임자와 껄끄러웠다)

The bustling movements of the Army Headquarters secretariat staff, rushing back and forth, seemed somehow different from usual, but Paik Sun-yup, sitting in his office and absentmindedly watching the commotion outside his door, had little idea of what was actually happening. True to his character of focusing solely on his tasks, Paik paid no attention to such minor disturbances. It was only after receiving a summons from the Office of the President (Gyeongmudae), leaving the Daegu Army Headquarters, and arriving in Busan that he reportedly had a premonition that this "certain event" might be a ceremony for him. As he entered the temporary Gyeongmudae reception room set up in the Gyeongsangnam-do Governor's office, he said the first thing that caught his eye was the hurried activity of the presidential secretariat staff. <<> Then, the President and the outgoing commander of the U.S. Eighth Army, General James Van Fleet, appeared. The secretariat staff stopped moving, and one of them announced, "We will now begin the promotion ceremony for Army Chief of Staff Paik Sun-yup." The President and Commander Van Fleet approached Paik. Soon, President Syngman Rhee and Commander Van Fleet stood on either side of Paik, flanking him. Then, the Army Headquarters secretariat staff, who had been busy preparing for this 'certain event,' placed the four-star rank insignia onto Paik's shoulders. It was the first-ever four-star general rank insignia of the Republic of Korea, pinned on by President Rhee and General Van Fleet. <<> There are quite a few people who downplay his contributions during the Korean War, asking, "Did Paik Sun-yup fight alone?" Some say, "He lived to be 100, so he could talk about his achievements from his own perspective." Others deride his military exploits by bringing up his background in the Manchurian Army. In such instances, it is necessary to examine the significance of his becoming the 'Republic of Korea's first four-star general.' <<> The three years and one month of the Korean War was not a war conducted independently by the South Korean military. From the early stages, U.S. military involvement became full-fledged, and after the massive intervention of the Chinese Communist forces, South Korea had to rely absolutely on the U.S.-centric United Nations Command. Consequently, all operations that unfolded were inevitably dictated or curtailed by the influence of the U.S. military, which held wartime operational control. Therefore, amidst the fierce fighting, every major Korean commander on the front lines could not escape the strict scrutiny of the U.S. military. <<> Paik Sun-yup was the most prominent Korean commander during the initial phase of the war and the intense mobile warfare that unfolded in the following year. He subsequently successfully led the U.S.-led armistice negotiations, the suppression of partisans on Jirisan Mountain, and the re-establishment of the II Corps, which was the first step in the modernization of the South Korean military. He displayed highly impressive performance in various fields, including field combat, meticulous mobile warfare, and flawless military administration. The U.S. military fully recognized this and supported him. In the operations logs of the U.S. Eighth Army commander and evaluation documents from the U.S. Military Advisory Group, Paik's activities are frequently mentioned by name or under designations like the "ROK 1st Division." <<> Thus, with the strong backing of the U.S. military, he rose to become the first four-star general of the Republic of Korea. During the war, he added a star roughly every ten months. President Syngman Rhee reportedly said the following as he pinned the rank insignia onto Paik's shoulder. <<> "In the old days, this position was that of a sovereign (Wonsu). It was a rank only a king could hold. But isn't this a Republic now? Congratulations." This could be interpreted as a statement carrying a certain message. The person who placed the four-star general's epaulette on Paik's other shoulder was General Van Fleet, the commander of the U.S. Eighth Army. The fact that the Eighth Army commander, the main figure who actually led the war, attended Paik's promotion ceremony and personally pinned on his rank insignia is also highly significant. <<> Even after reaching the highest rank in the military, Paik Sun-yup's journey was not over. Instead, various new circumstances were unfolding. One of these was that General Van Fleet, the U.S. Eighth Army commander who loved Korea and fought to support it, was leaving his post, and a new commander with a completely different personality was arriving. The incoming U.S. Eighth Army commander, set to take over in Korea, was General Maxwell Taylor. <<> He was a lieutenant general at the time of his assignment to the Korean front. Therefore, his rank was one step lower than the newly promoted General Paik Sun-yup. However, he was a brilliant commander from World War II. He was also 19 years Paik's senior. He had experience serving as a U.S. military attaché in Japan and was highly capable, speaking six languages. During the Normandy landings, he served as the commander of the 101st Airborne Division. The story of the airborne division featured in the early parts of the later U.S.-made 'Band of Brothers' is about him. An excellent commander, Taylor later became the 20th Chief of Staff of the U.S. Army. <<> This Taylor was very strict and cold. Additionally, perhaps due to his experience stationed in Japan, word circulated early in his tenure on the Korean front that he preferred Korean commanders who were graduates of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy. In his memoirs, General Paik Sun-yup stated, "I understood that Commander Taylor, who was impressed by the curriculum of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy and the excellence of its graduates, compiled a list of figures from our military who were graduates of that academy to work with him upon his arrival in Korea." <<> Looking at this from the other side, it also meant that the standing of Paik Sun-yup, who was not a graduate of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy, was undermined. In fact, Paik, who had worked in such close harmony with his predecessor, General Van Fleet—almost like a 'perfect pair'—reportedly did not make a favorable impression on Taylor. <<> The atmosphere was not pleasant from the very moment Taylor set foot in Korea. He appeared not to hold the status of the South Korean military in high regard, and it was said he was visibly displeased that Paik, 19 years his junior and wearing the higher rank of four-star general, had come to the airport to greet him. The broad-minded and Korea-loving former commander, Van Fleet, was about to leave, and a new commander, brimming with elite pride and self-confidence, had taken over. For Paik Sun-yup, a new battlefield without gunfire was unfolding. <<> In a situation where the armistice had to be accepted as a fait accompli, the positions of President Syngman Rhee and the U.S. administration were increasingly diverging. The conflict was escalating. Paik had to maintain meticulous cooperation with the U.S. military, which held the actual reins of the entire battlefield, while also closely following the opinions of the South Korean president. Amidst all this, the arrival of the coldly rational Taylor was no minor change. Paik was now in a position where he had to face a new test set by the U.S. military, one different from before. <<> (서로 바삐 오가는 육군본부 비서진들 움직임은 어딘가 평소와 달랐지만, 사무실에 앉아 문 밖 동정을 무심히 바라만 보던 백선엽은 실제 어떤 일이 벌어지는지 잘 몰랐다. 할 일에만 몰두하는 성격 그대로 백선엽은 그 같은 작은 동정에 신경을 쓰지 않았다. 급기야 경무대 호출을 받고 대구 육군본부를 떠나 부산에 도착한 뒤에야 ‘어떤 일’이라는 것이 자신을 위한 행사일지 모른다는 예감만을 받았다고 한다. 경남 지사 사무실에 마련했던 임시 경무대 응접실에 들어서자 그곳 역시 대통령 비서진들의 분주한 동정이 먼저 눈에 들어왔다고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Eliminates Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Powers, Leaving Only Investigation Request Rights (與, 검찰 보완수사권 없애고 수사 요구권만 남겼다)
item.description:
Democratic Party Eliminates Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Powers, Leaving Only Investigation Request Rights (與, 검찰 보완수사권 없애고 수사 요구권만 남겼다)

On the 9th, the Democratic Party of Korea virtually put forward a party-led amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers. This bill has been seen by the Democratic Party as the finale of 'prosecution reform,' following the abolition of prosecutors' direct investigative authority starting in October through the Public Prosecution Office Act and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office Act. While cautious opinions had been raised not only by the prosecution but also within the government and ruling party circles regarding the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, the party's hardline supporters drove public opinion, leading to the final confirmation of the abolition. Although the prosecution's supplementary investigation recently revealed police negligence and collusion in the 'Jeonnam Gwangju high school girl murder case,' the Democratic Party plans to process the bill before the party convention on August 17. (더불어민주당은 9일 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안을 사실상 당론으로 발의했다. 공소청법과 중대범죄수사청(중수청)법을 통해 10월부터 검사의 직접 수사 권한을 폐지한 민주당이 ‘검찰 개혁’의 피날레로 여겨왔던 법안이다. 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부에 대해 그간 검찰은 물론 정부와 여권 일각에서도 신중론이 제기됐지만 여당 강성 지지층이 여론을 주도하며 폐지가 최종 확정됐다. 최근 ‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’에서 경찰의 부실 수사와 유착 정황이 검찰의 보완수사로 드러났지만, 민주당은 8월 17일 전당대회 전까지 법안을 처리하겠다는 방침이다.)

The Democratic Party's task force for amending the Criminal Procedure Act held a meeting that day and finalized the amendment, submitting it to the National Assembly. The amendment removes prosecutors' authority to conduct supplementary investigations, which served as a check and balance on police investigations. Instead, it retains only the 'right to request supplementary investigations,' allowing prosecutors to ask the police for additional inquiries. (민주당 형소법 개정 태스크포스(TF)는 이날 회의를 열고 형소법 개정안을 확정해 국회에 제출했다. 개정안엔 경찰 수사에 대한 보완·견제 장치인 검사의 보완수사 권한이 삭제됐다. 대신 검사가 경찰에 보완 수사를 요구할 수 있는 ‘보완수사 요구권’만 남기기로 했다.)

The bill also includes provisions to transfer cases to other investigative agencies, such as the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, if illegal activities by police investigators are discovered. Additionally, if the police officer handling a supplementary investigation is deemed unsuitable for the case, the head of the public prosecution office can request a replacement or disciplinary action. The Democratic Party plans to review the bill in a subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 10th. (경찰 수사관의 불법 수사 행위 등이 발견되면 중수청 등 다른 수사 기관에 사건을 보낼 수 있는 내용도 포함됐다. 또 보완수사를 담당한 경찰이 사건을 담당하기에 적절치 않다고 판단되면 공소청장이 수사관 교체나 징계를 요구할 수 있다. 민주당은 10일 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사소위를 열어 법안을 심사할 계획이다.)

However, legal circles have warned that "without supplementary investigation powers, it is highly likely that cases like the Gwangju high school girl murder suspect Jang Yun-gi, where police attempted to cover up the incident, would go undetected from the outside." They also question the effectiveness of the right to request supplementary investigations, expressing concerns that "the issues of case concealment and investigative delays will become more severe." (하지만 법조계에선 “보완수사권이 없으면 전남광주 여고생 살해 피의자인 장윤기 사건처럼 경찰의 사건 은폐를 외부에서 발견하지 못할 가능성이 크다”고 했다. 또 보완수사 요구권의 실효성에 의문을 표하며 “사건 암장, 수사 지연 문제가 더욱 심각해질 것”이라는 우려도 나오고 있다.)

◇ Claims of strengthening the right to request supplementary investigations... but no way to enforce it if the police stonewall (◇보완수사 요구권 강화한다지만… 경찰이 뭉개면 강제할 방법 없어)

On the 9th, the Democratic Party's task force for amending the Criminal Procedure Act explained that while prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers are being abolished, the authority to request such investigations has been strengthened. In response to concerns about the police monopolizing investigations, they stated, "We have put in place numerous safeguards to ensure investigative fairness." Kim Han-gyu, the senior deputy floor leader, said the amendment "can be processed before the (August) party convention." (민주당 형사소송법 개정 TF는 9일 형소법 개정안을 발의하면서 검사의 보완수사권은 폐지되지만 보완수사 요구 권한은 강화됐다고 설명했다. 경찰이 수사를 독점할 수 있다는 우려에 대해 “수사 공정성을 확보할 안전 장치를 다수 마련했다”고 했다. 김한규 원내 수석 부대표는 형소법 개정안을 “(8월) 전당대회 전까지 처리할 수 있다”고 했다.)

The amendment released by the Democratic Party that day requires judicial police officers who receive a request for supplementary investigation to complete it within one month. For cases where the statute of limitations is imminent, the completion period is shorter than one month. Previously, an amendment proposed by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min had set the deadline for supplementary investigations at three months. (민주당이 이날 공개한 형소법 개정안은 보완수사 요구를 받은 사법경찰관은 1개월 이내에 보완수사를 완료하도록 했다. 공소시효가 임박한 사건 등에 대해선 1개월보다 더 짧은 기한 내에 보완 수사를 완료하도록 했다. 앞서 민주당 김용민 의원 등이 발의한 개정안에선 보완수사 기한을 3개월 이내로 정했었다.)

It also stipulates that if the police fail to comply with a request for supplementary investigation without justifiable reason, the prosecutor can demand exclusion from duties, replacement, or disciplinary action. However, the disciplinary process must go through the police's internal disciplinary committee. Critics point out that this raises the possibility of internal police members imposing lenient punishments. The amendment also allows for cases to be reported and transferred to other investigative agencies, such as the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, if the investigator is deemed unsuitable due to suspicions of criminal activity. (또 경찰이 정당한 이유 없이 보완수사 요구를 따르지 않을 경우 직무배제·교체 혹은 징계를 요구할 수 있다고도 규정했다. 다만 징계 절차는 경찰 내부 징계위원회 등을 거치도록 했다. 경찰 내부 구성원들이 ‘솜방망이’ 징계를 내릴 가능성이 있다는 지적이 나오는 대목이다. 개정안은 수사 담당자의 범죄 행위가 의심되는 등 사건을 담당하기에 부적절하다고 판단되는 경우 중수청 등 다른 수사기관에 사건을 통보하고 이첩할 수 있도록 했다.)

Kim Han-gyu, the Democratic Party's senior deputy floor leader, stated, "The Jang Yun-gi incident occurred even though supplementary investigation powers existed. Simply retaining them wouldn't prevent cases like Jang Yun-gi's." He added, "What's important is to prevent such incidents by stopping police from conducting investigations based on their own interests, through self-correction and checks among investigative agencies." (김한규 민주당 원내 수석 부대표는 “보완수사권이 있음에도 장윤기 사건이 발생했다. 존치한다고 해서 장윤기 사건 같은 게 없어지는 게 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “중요한 것은 경찰의 이해관계 수사를 막는 방식으로 그런 사건이 발생하지 않도록 수사기관이 자정과 견제를 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

However, many experts express concerns about the amendment. Cha Jin-ah, a professor at Korea University Law School, said, "If prosecutors' investigative authority is abolished, the police's workload will increase, making it highly likely they will conduct supplementary investigations perfunctorily before sending cases to the prosecution." This could lead to a decline in investigative quality. Kim Jong-min, a lawyer at MK Partners Law Firm, noted, "If the police provide various justifications for not carrying out supplementary investigations, there is no way to enforce compliance." (하지만 개정안에 우려를 표시하는 전문가도 적지 않다. 차진아 고려대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “검사의 수사권이 폐지되면 경찰의 업무 부담이 가중돼 형식적으로 보완수사를 해 사건을 송치할 가능성이 높아질 것”이라고 했다. 수사의 질이 떨어질 가능성이 크다는 것이다. 김종민 법무법인 MK파트너스 변호사는 “경찰이 각종 근거를 대며 보완수사를 이행하지 않을 경우 강제할 방법이 없다”고 했다.)

Park Chan-un, a professor at Hanyang University and former chair of the advisory committee for the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office, expressed concern that in cases like Jang Yun-gi's, where there is a high likelihood of systematic police cover-ups, it would be difficult to uncover the truth through requests for supplementary investigations. On Facebook, Park wrote, "To request a supplementary investigation, you need clues, which are often discovered during direct supplementary investigations, not just from records. In such cases, the police tend not to leave gaps in the records." (국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단 자문위원장을 지낸 박찬운 한양대 교수는 장윤기 사건처럼 경찰의 조직적 은폐 가능성이 큰 사건일수록 보완 수사 요구를 통해 진실을 발견하기 어려울 가능성을 우려했다. 박 교수는 페이스북에 “보완수사를 요구하기 위해서는 단서가 필요한데, 그것은 직접 보완수사를 할 때 발견되는 것이지 기록만으로 알기 어렵다”며 “이런 사건일수록 기록상 허점을 남기지 않는다”고 했다.)

Observers suggest that despite growing concerns over the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers highlighted by the Jang Yun-gi case, the Democratic Party's push for swift and complete abolition is not unrelated to the upcoming party leadership race. A Democratic Party lawmaker, speaking on condition of anonymity, said, "Some lawmakers feel the discussion is moving very hastily, but it's difficult to raise objections publicly." Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho is also said to have told Democratic Party lawmakers at a private dinner the previous day, "Abolishing supplementary investigation powers would harm ordinary citizens due to inadequate police investigations." (장윤기 사건으로 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 우려가 커지는 상황에서도 민주당이 전면 폐지 속도전에 나선 건 차기 당권 경쟁과 무관치 않다는 관측이다. 익명을 요구한 한 민주당 의원은 “최근 논의가 매우 성급하게 진행되고 있다고 생각하는 의원이 있지만 공개적으로 문제 제기하기 어려운 상황”이라고 했다. 정성호 법무장관도 전날 민주당 법사위원들과의 비공개 만찬에서 “보완수사권을 폐지하면 경찰 부실 수사로 힘없는 서민이 피해를 입게 될 것”이라고 말한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Former People Power Party lawmaker Kim Woong, a former senior prosecutor, said in a phone call with this newspaper, "Those in the Democratic Party pushing for so-called prosecution reform don't seem to know what they're doing or what will happen because they've never actually conducted investigations." He added, "They don't understand how important supplementary investigations are and are using this as a tool for internal power struggles, and in the end, it's the citizens who will suffer." (부장검사 출신인 김웅 전 국민의힘 의원은 본지 통화에서 “민주당에서 소위 검찰 개혁을 추진하는 사람들은 실제로 수사를 해본 적이 없어서 자기들이 무슨 일을 하는지, 어떤 일이 벌어질지 모르는 것 같다”며 “보완수사가 얼마나 중요한지 알지 못한 채 이를 내부 권력 투쟁의 도구로 삼는 것인데 결국 피해는 국민이 입게 된다”고 했다.)

Amid this, former Democratic Party lawmaker Choi Kang-wook appeared on the pro-government YouTube channel 'Maebul Show' on the 8th and argued, "If there are problems with police investigations, prosecutors should just inform the media. If they make it public, the police can't just sweep it under the rug." Choi had led discussions on separating investigation and prosecution during his tenure as a lawmaker. However, even within the ruling bloc, criticism emerged that "this is not only an unrealistic plan that violates the criminal law prohibition on disclosing suspect information, but it also shifts the responsibility of state agencies onto civilians." (이런 가운데 최강욱 전 민주당 의원은 지난 8일 친여 성향 유튜브 채널인 ‘매불쇼’에 출연해 “(경찰 수사가 문제가 있을 경우) 검사가 언론에 알리면 된다. (언론에) 공표하면 경찰이 뭉개고 넘어갈 수는 없다”고 주장했다. 최 전 의원은 의원 시절 수사·기소 분리 논의를 주도했었다. 그러나 여권 내에서도 “형법상 피의사실 공표 금지를 어기는 비현실적인 방안일 뿐더러 국가 기관이 수사 책임을 민간에 전가하는 것”이란 비판이 나왔다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min, classified as a hardliner, appeared on 'Maebul Show' that day and responded to a question about "what if problems are concealed," saying, "Discussions are underway to allow crime victims to make statements and request meetings whenever necessary during the investigation process." The broadcast drew comments like, "So you're telling victims to do what prosecutors used to handle themselves?" (강경파로 분류되는 민주당 김용민 의원도 이날 ‘매불쇼’에서 ‘(경찰 수사 문제점이) 은폐된 상황이면 어떡하느냐’는 취지의 질문에 “범죄 피해자들이 (수사 과정에서) 의견 진술도 필요하면 수시로 할 수 있고 면담 요청을 할 수 있게 하는 제도가 논의되고 있다”고 했다. 이 방송엔 “검사가 알아서 하던 걸 피해자가 직접 하라는 것이냐”는 댓글이 달렸다.)

The People Power Party said that day, "Isn't this ultimately about creating a paradise for criminals?" They are considering proposing an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that maintains supplementary investigation powers. (국민의힘은 이날 “결국 범죄자 천국을 만들겠다는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 국민의힘은 보완수사권을 유지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 발의하는 방안을 고려 중이다.)

item.title: President Lee: “If True, Stern Measures” over Alleged IKEA Parental Leave Disadvantages (李대통령, ‘이케아 육아휴직 불이익’ 의혹에 “사실이라면 엄정 조치”)
item.description:
President Lee: “If True, Stern Measures” over Alleged IKEA Parental Leave Disadvantages (李대통령, ‘이케아 육아휴직 불이익’ 의혹에 “사실이라면 엄정 조치”)

President Lee Jae-myung shared a media report on the 10th stating that the Ministry of Employment and Labor has launched an investigation into allegations that Swedish furniture company IKEA demoted and pressured a returning employee after parental leave to resign voluntarily, saying, “We will thoroughly investigate, and if it is confirmed to be true, we will take stern measures in accordance with international standards.” (이재명 대통령은 10일 스웨덴 가구 기업 이케아(IKEA)가 육아 휴직을 쓰고 돌아온 직원의 직급을 강등하고 권고사직을 종용했다는 의혹이 있어 고용노동부가 조사에 나섰다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하면서 “철저히 조사해서 사실로 밝혀진다면 국제적 기준에 맞게 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee, who is on a state visit to Mongolia, stated in a post on X (formerly Twitter) that morning, “Just as our companies should not engage in anti-labor, irrational behavior abroad, foreign companies should not do so here either.” (몽골 국빈 방문 중인 이 대통령은 이날 오전 X(옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “우리 기업도 해외에서 반노동 비상식 행태를 보여서는 안 되는 것처럼 외국 기업도 국내에서 그래선 안 된다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, “There was a time when a globally exemplary company in other countries caused backlash by engaging in anti-labor and opaque management practices specifically in our country,” adding, “While that was an era when our government pursued anti-labor policies and was tainted with corruption, now that South Korea is transforming into a model society and government leading the world, such outdated management practices cannot be tolerated if they occur.” (이 대통령은 “한때 다른 나라에선 모범적인 글로벌 기업이 유독 우리나라에서만 반노동적이고 불투명한 경영을 해서 빈축을 사는 경우가 있었다”며 “우리나라 정부가 반노동 정책을 구사하고 부정부패로 물들어 있던 시절의 이야기지만, 이제는 대한민국이 세계를 선도하는 모범 사회, 모범 정부로 거듭나고 있는데 그러한 구태 경영 행태가 발생한다면 용납할 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Internal Opposition Rises Within Ruling Party Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Some Exceptions Must Be Allowed" (보완수사권 폐지에 與 내부 반기… “일부 예외 인정해야”)
item.description:
Internal Opposition Rises Within Ruling Party Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Some Exceptions Must Be Allowed" (보완수사권 폐지에 與 내부 반기… “일부 예외 인정해야”)

While the Democratic Party of Korea effectively proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act as a party line on the 9th, which would completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers and only retain the right to request supplementary investigations, claims have emerged within the Democratic Party itself that "the supplementary investigation powers should be partially preserved." (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전히 폐지하고 보완수사 요구권만 남기는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 지난 9일 사실상 당론으로 발의한 가운데, 민주당 내에서도 “보완수사권을 일부 존치해야 한다”는 주장이 나왔다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Hong Ki-won said in an interview with KBS Radio's "Jeon Gyeok Si-sa" on the 10th, "The bill proposed by the party yesterday seems to have put in place many safety measures to address the absence of supplementary investigation powers, but it cannot fundamentally resolve the problems that arise when those powers are abolished." He added, "There are cases where the supplementary investigation powers must be partially preserved." <<> Lawmaker Hong stated, "If supplementary investigations are completely prohibited, the number of requests for supplementary investigations will increase significantly," and "Inevitably, the investigation period will become longer in the future." He explained, "Crime victims such as children, the elderly, and the disabled have limited ability to protect themselves. If the police get the initial direction wrong or fail to listen to the victims' claims, there is a high likelihood of distortion." He further noted, "If a prosecutor cannot directly conduct a supplementary investigation, they must request the responsible investigator to redo and supplement the investigation, but that is not easy. Changing the direction of one's own investigation to pursue a new path is challenging." <<> He said, "In detention cases, the detention period is usually 20 days, or 30 days if extended, and requesting a supplementary investigation to handle it could take a lot of time. There could be many cases that inevitably end up as non-detention indictments." He added, "There are also cases where the statute of limitations is imminent. Going through the process of requesting a supplementary investigation could cause the statute of limitations to expire." Furthermore, he noted, "There are cases that require a consolidated investigation. Requesting each police station to supplement and reinvestigate could lead to difficulties." <<> The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee will convene a subcommittee on bill review this day to begin discussions on bills that include the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. Lawmaker Hong said, "I have only argued that deliberation is necessary until now, but since bills that completely abolish supplementary investigation powers have already been proposed, discussions are progressing rapidly. I have been preparing to propose a bill, thinking that I need to present an alternative to continue this argument. The gist of it is to partially preserve the supplementary investigation powers." <<> He elaborated, "It's basically about making supplementary investigation requests the principle, but recognizing exceptions so that prosecutors can conduct supplementary investigations in specific cases." These cases include "crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups, some livelihood-related cases, detention cases or cases where the statute of limitations is imminent, and cases that require a consolidated investigation of incidents occurring simultaneously in multiple locations." He added, "It should be done by obtaining approval from the local chief prosecutor and having the civilian-based Case Review Committee of the prosecution office review whether the prosecutor's supplementary investigation is appropriate." <<> Lawmaker Hong stated, "President Lee Jae-myung also said in March that 'completely abolishing the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers could cause problems.'" He added, "I believe he intended to convey that the supplementary investigation powers should be partially preserved and that the National Assembly should deliberate and handle it properly." (홍기원 민주당 의원은 10일 KBS라디오 전격시사 인터뷰에서 “어제 당에서 발의한 법안의 내용이 보완수사권이 없을 경우에 여러 안전장치를 많이 마련한 것 같기는 한데, 보완수사권을 폐지했을 때 생기는 그런 문제들을 본질적으로 해소할 수는 없다”며 “보완수사권을 일부 존치해야만 하는 그런 사안들이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Strengthening mineral partnership with Mongolia... Ushering in a golden age" (李 “몽골과 광물 파트너십 강화… 황금시대 열자”)
item.description:
Lee: "Strengthening mineral partnership with Mongolia... Ushering in a golden age" (李 “몽골과 광물 파트너십 강화… 황금시대 열자”)

President Lee Jae-myung paid a state visit to Mongolia on the 9th (local time) and held a summit meeting with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh in Ulaanbaatar. It is the first state visit by a South Korean president to Mongolia in 15 years. President Lee, alongside President Khürelsükh, reviewed an honor guard at the official welcome ceremony held at Sükhbaatar Square in Ulaanbaatar. After moving to the Mongolian government building, President Lee wrote in the guestbook, "Let us open a golden age for South Korea-Mongolia relations based on friendship and trust." (이재명 대통령이 9일(현지 시각) 몽골을 국빈 방문해 울란바타르에서 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령과 정상회담을 했다. 한국 정상이 몽골을 국빈 방문한 것은 15년 만이다. 이 대통령은 울란바타르 수흐바타르 광장에서 열린 공식 환영식에서 후렐수흐 대통령과 함께 의장대를 사열했다. 이어 몽골 정부 청사로 이동한 이 대통령은 방명록에 “우정과 신뢰 위에 한·몽 황금시대를 열어갑시다”라고 썼다.)

During the subsequent summit meeting, President Lee stated, "I appreciate Mongolia's constructive role and support in advancing the situation on the Korean Peninsula, and I look forward to continuing cooperation to promote peace and collaboration on the Korean Peninsula." (이어진 정상회담에서 이 대통령은 “한반도 정세 진전을 위한 몽골의 건설적인 역할과 지지에 감사드리면서 한반도 평화와 협력 증진을 위해 지속적으로 협력해 나가기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Khürelsükh responded, "The Republic of Korea is Mongolia's 'third neighbor' and an important strategic partner." The 'third neighbor' policy refers to Mongolia's diplomatic strategy to reduce its dependence on China and Russia by increasing cooperation with the liberal democratic camp. (후렐수흐 대통령은 “대한민국은 몽골의 ‘제3의 이웃’이자 중요한 전략적 동반자 관계에 있는 국가”라고 화답했다. ‘제3의 이웃’ 정책이란 중국과 러시아에 대한 의존도를 낮추기 위해 자유민주주의 진영과의 협력을 늘려가겠다는 몽골의 외교 정책이다.)

Following the summit, in a joint press announcement, the two leaders officially declared the principled conclusion of the 'South Korea-Mongolia Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA).' Taking this as a turning point, they agreed to increase bilateral trade volume, which stood at $690 million last year, to $1 billion (approximately 1.38 trillion won) by 2030. On the same day, the two countries signed 21 MOUs, including cooperation in distribution and logistics. The leaders also attended the 'Korea-Mongolia Business Forum' alongside South Korean business figures such as LS Holdings Chairman Koo Ja-eun and POSCO Holdings Chairman Jang In-hwa. (정상회담 뒤 공동 언론 발표에서 두 정상은 ‘한·몽골 포괄적 경제동반자협정(CEPA)’의 원칙적 타결을 공식 선언하고, 이를 계기로 지난해 6억9000만달러 수준이었던 양국 간 교역 규모를 2030년까지 10억달러(약 1조3800억원) 수준까지 끌어올리기로 했다. 이날 양국은 유통 물류 협력을 포함해 21건의 MOU도 체결했다. 두 정상은 이날 구자은 LS홀딩스 회장, 장인화 포스코홀딩스 회장 등 우리 기업인과 함께 ‘한·몽 비즈니스 포럼’에도 참석했다.)

The two countries decided to significantly strengthen their supply chain partnership to ensure a stable supply of Mongolia's abundant critical minerals. In an interview with Mongolia's state news agency MONTSAME released that day, President Lee stated, "We can create a model where we participate together across the entire lifecycle of the critical minerals supply chain." Mongolia's rare earth reserves are approximately 31 million tons, ranking second in the world after China (44 million tons). Its estimated copper reserves are also the second largest in the world, reaching up to 55 million tons. The country is also rich in coal, molybdenum, lithium, and tungsten. (양국은 몽골의 풍부한 핵심 광물을 안정적으로 확보하기 위한 공급망 파트너십을 대폭 강화하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 공개된 몽골 국영통신사 몬차메(MONTSAME)와의 인터뷰에서 “핵심 광물 공급망 사업 전주기에 걸쳐 함께 참여하는 모델을 만들 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 몽골 희토류 매장량은 약 3100만t으로 중국(4400만t)에 이은 세계 2위다. 구리 매장량 추정치도 세계 2위 규모로 최대 5500만t에 달한다. 석탄·몰리브덴·리튬·텅스텐 등도 풍부하다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Spends Billions on Overseas Business Trips (해외 출장 비용으로 수십억 쓰는 국회의장님)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Spends Billions on Overseas Business Trips (해외 출장 비용으로 수십억 쓰는 국회의장님)

It was confirmed on the 9th that six former National Assembly Speakers have taken a total of 80 overseas trips. The budget for these trips was tallied at 30.61519 billion won. The most frequent traveler during their tenure was former Speaker Kim Jin-pyo, while former Speaker Woo Won-shik had the highest average budget per trip. (역대 국회의장 6명이 총 80차례 해외 출장을 다녀온 것으로 9일 확인됐다. 출장 예산은 306억1519만원으로 집계됐다. 임기 내 최다 출장자는 김진표 전 의장이었고, 회당 평균 출장 예산이 가장 많았던 사례는 우원식 전 의장이었다.)

According to data on 'National Assembly Speakers' Overseas Trip Status' submitted by the National Assembly Secretariat to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Seung-soo, former Speaker Kim Jin-pyo made the most trips with 17. Following him were former Speakers Jung Ui-hwa and Woo Won-shik with 14 trips each, former Speakers Chung Sye-kyun and Park Byeong-seug with 13 trips each, and former Speaker Moon Hee-sang with 9 trips. The term of a National Assembly Speaker is two years, meaning they roughly took overseas trips once every two months on average. This data covers statistics from October 2014 to May of this year, and during this period, except for former Speaker Jung Ui-hwa, the other five Speakers were from the Democratic Party. <<> In terms of overseas trip budgets, former Speaker Kim Jin-pyo spent 9.08063 billion won, and former Speaker Woo Won-shik spent 8.28694 billion won. It is analyzed that these two former Speakers had relatively higher trip costs because they formed large delegations for long-distance trips. Compared to them, the budgets for the other former Speakers—Park Byeong-seug (4.17102 billion won), Chung Sye-kyun (3.30557 billion won), Moon Hee-sang (3.01541 billion won), and Jung Ui-hwa (2.7556 billion won)—were about half that amount. <<> Former Speaker Woo Won-shik was found to have spent the most budget per overseas trip, averaging 591.92 million won per trip. He was followed by former Speaker Kim Jin-pyo (534.15 million won), former Speaker Moon Hee-sang (335.04 million won), former Speaker Park Byeong-seug (320.84 million won), former Speaker Chung Sye-kyun (254.27 million won), and former Speaker Jung Ui-hwa (196.82 million won). In particular, former Speaker Woo Won-shik's visit to Brazil and Panama in November 2024 cost 1.16961 billion won. This was the highest single-trip cost during the period. <<> The country most frequently visited by the Speakers was Indonesia (7 times). All six Speakers had visited Indonesia. A diplomatic source explained, "Indonesia is the center of Asian parliamentary diplomacy, and various international forums are frequently held there." Other frequently visited countries included Japan (6 times), the United States (5 times), China (5 times), Vietnam (5 times), Türkiye (5 times), and Russia (5 times). Lawmaker Kim Seung-soo said, "The details of the National Assembly Speaker's trips must be disclosed transparently to prevent the public from misunderstanding them as junkets." (국회사무처가 국민의힘 김승수 의원실에 제출한 ‘국회의장 해외 출장 현황’ 자료에 따르면, 김진표 전 의장이 17회로 가장 많은 출장을 다녀왔다. 다음으로 정의화·우원식 전 의장이 14회, 정세균·박병석 전 의장이 13회, 문희상 전 의장이 9회였다. 국회의장 임기는 2년으로, 대체적으로 두 달에 한 번꼴로 해외 출장을 다녀온 셈이다. 이번 자료는 2014년 10월부터 올해 5월까지 통계로 이 기간 동안 정의화 전 의장을 뺀 나머지 5명의 국회의장은 민주당 출신이었다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Pushes Ahead with Half-Empty Parliament... Schedules Football Association Hearing Without Opposition (與, 반쪽 국회 강행… 野 없이 ‘축구협 청문회’ 일정 잡아)
item.description:
Ruling Party Pushes Ahead with Half-Empty Parliament... Schedules Football Association Hearing Without Opposition (與, 반쪽 국회 강행… 野 없이 ‘축구협 청문회’ 일정 잡아)

On the 9th, the National Assembly held plenary sessions in three standing committees without the participation of the People Power Party (PPP), receiving government briefings and voting on the agenda for a hearing on the Korea Football Association. With the PPP boycotting in protest of what it sees as unilateral committee assignments, the Democratic Party (DP) took the lead in operating the committees. The DP has stated its intent to pass bills even without the PPP. (국회가 9일 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 상임위원회 3곳에서 전체회의를 열고 정부 업무 보고를 받고, 축구협회 청문회 안건을 의결했다. 국민의힘이 일방적 상임위 배정에 반발해 참여를 거부한 상황에서 더불어민주당 주도로 상임위를 가동한 것이다. 민주당은 국민의힘 없이 법안도 의결하겠다는 입장이다.)

The National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee, Agriculture, Food, Rural Affairs, Oceans and Fisheries Committee, and Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee, all chaired by DP lawmakers, held plenary sessions on this day. The Strategy and Finance Committee received briefings from related ministries and agencies, including the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Bank of Korea, the Korea Minting and Security Printing Corporation, and the Korea Investment Corporation. DP, Reform Party, and independent lawmakers attended, but PPP lawmakers were absent. The Agriculture, Oceans and Fisheries Committee and the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee, attended only by DP and Rebuilding Korea Party lawmakers, appointed secretaries and approved the formation of subcommittees. (민주당 의원이 위원장을 맡고 있는 국회 재정경제기획위원회와 농림축산식품해양수산위원회, 문화체육관광위원회는 이날 전체회의를 열었다. 재경위는 기획예산처, 한국은행, 한국조폐공사, 한국투자공사 등 소관 부처와 기관에서 업무 보고를 받았다. 민주당, 개혁신당, 무소속 의원 등은 참석했지만 국민의힘 의원은 불참했다. 농해수위와 문체위도 민주당과 조국혁신당 의원 등만 참석해 간사를 선임하고 소위원회 구성안을 의결했다.)

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee also finalized the hearing schedule despite the PPP's absence. In its plenary session, the committee submitted and approved a plan to hold a hearing on pending issues related to the Korea Football Association. The hearing, scheduled for the 22nd at the National Assembly, will address allegations of mismanagement within the Korea Football Association concerning the 2026 North and Central America World Cup and controversies surrounding the appointment process of former national team coach Hong Myung-bo. The committee has summoned former KFA President Chung Mong-gyu, former KFA Technical Director Lee Im-saeng, and former coach Hong as witnesses, while naming Park Ji-sung, chairman of the K-Reform Football Committee, and players Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan as references. (문체위는 이날 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 청문회 일정도 확정했다. 문체위는 이날 전체회의에서 ‘대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회’ 실시 계획서 채택의 건을 상정해 처리했다. 2026 북중미 월드컵과 관련해 대한축구협회 부실 운영 의혹과 홍명보 전 국가대표팀 감독 선임 과정 논란 등에 대해 22일 국회에서 청문회를 열겠다는 것이다. 문체위는 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장, 이임생 전 축구협회 기술총괄이사, 홍 전 감독 등을 증인으로 채택했고, 박지성 K-축구 혁신위원장과 손흥민·황희찬 선수 등은 참고인으로 의결했다.)

PPP lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, a former national shooting athlete, posted on Facebook, "Can a half-baked hearing change Korean football? Is this just a 'scolding show' to boost approval ratings?" adding, "KFA reform should not be used as a political event for the DP. Normalize the National Assembly first." The National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee is also pushing for a hearing on the Homeplus incident. DP lawmakers on the National Defense Committee held a press conference, urging their PPP counterparts to attend committee meetings, stating, "Boycotting the National Defense Committee is taking national security hostage for political strife." (사격 국가대표 출신인 진종오 국민의힘 의원은 페이스북에서 “반쪽 청문회로 한국 축구를 바꿀 수 있나. ‘호통 쇼’로 지지율을 벌자는 것이냐”며 “축구협회 개혁은 민주당의 정치 이벤트에 활용돼선 안 된다. 국회부터 정상화하라”고 했다. 국회 정무위원회도 홈플러스 사태 관련 청문회를 추진 중이다. 국방위원회 소속 민주당 의원들은 기자회견을 열어 “국방위 보이콧은 국가 안보를 정쟁의 인질로 삼는 것”이라며 국민의힘 의원들에게 국방위 회의에 참석하라고 요구했다.)

Although the ruling and opposition parties negotiated the formation of the second-half National Assembly committees last month, the talks broke down after the DP rejected the PPP's demand to chair the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. The PPP argues that the opposition should hold the Judiciary Committee chairmanship to check the ruling party's dominance, while the DP insists it cannot relinquish the post to swiftly process legislation related to the second-year agenda of the Lee administration. Without the PPP's participation, the DP passed the election of chairs for 11 of the 18 standing committees during a plenary session on the 30th of last month, and starting with the Judiciary Committee on the 2nd, seven committees have held plenary sessions without the PPP as of today. (여야는 지난달 22대 후반기 국회 원 구성 협상을 벌였지만, 국회 법제사법위원회 위원장을 맡아야 한다는 국민의힘 요구를 민주당이 거부하면서 협상이 파행했다. 국민의힘은 거대 여당의 폭주를 견제하기 위해 야당이 법사위원장을 맡아야 한다고 주장하지만, 민주당은 이재명 정부 2년 차 국정 과제 관련 입법을 속도감 있게 처리하기 위해 법사위원장직을 내줄 수 없다는 입장이다. 민주당은 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 지난달 30일 본회의에서 18개 상임위 가운데 11곳의 위원장 선출안을 의결했고, 지난 2일 법사위를 시작으로 이날까지 상임위 7곳이 국민의힘 없이 전체회의를 열었다.)

DP Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do said at the party's policy coordination meeting, "We intended to hold a plenary session today to process pending livelihood bills, but as the PPP ultimately refused to cooperate in normalizing parliament, the handling of livelihood bills has been delayed again. We cannot just sit by and watch the PPP's unjustified parliamentary strike indefinitely. If the PPP continues its work slowdown, we will make a decision." PPP Floor Leader Chung Jeom-sik urged the DP to renegotiate the committee formation at the party's supreme council meeting, stating, "Our demand for the Judiciary Committee chairmanship is a request for a reasonable opportunity for debate so that bills can be processed through in-depth discussion." (한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 당 정책조정회의에서 “오늘 본회의를 열어 계류된 민생 법안을 처리하려고 했지만, 국민의힘이 끝내 국회 정상화에 협조하지 않으면서 민생 법안 처리는 또다시 뒤로 밀리게 됐다”며 “국민의힘의 명분 없는 국회 파업을 언제까지나 지켜만 보고 있을 수는 없다. 국민의힘이 태업을 지속한다면 결단을 내리겠다”고 했다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 당 최고위원회의에서 민주당 측에 원 구성 재협상을 촉구하며 “우리가 법사위원장직을 요구하는 것은 심도 있는 논의를 거쳐 법안을 처리할 수 있도록 합리적인 토론의 기회를 달라는 것”이라고 했다.)

The floor leaders of both parties met at the behest of National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik on this day but failed to narrow their differences. Speaker Woo said, "I have watched with patience, but it is regrettable to see that we are not meeting the public's expectations," and urged both parties to "quickly negotiate so that committee formation can be completed before Constitution Day on the 17th," according to Jang Hyun-joo, the speaker's senior secretary for communications. It was reported that while the floor leaders agreed on the need for swift negotiations as requested by the Speaker, there was no specific progress. (여야 원내대표는 이날 조정식 국회의장 주재로 회동했으나 이견을 좁히지 못했다. 조 의장은 “인내심을 갖고 지켜봤지만, 국민 기대에 부응하지 못하는 모습을 보면서 안타깝다”며 “오는 17일 제헌절 전까지 원 구성을 완료할 수 있도록 양당이 신속하게 협의하라”고 촉구했다고 장현주 의장실 공보소통수석이 전했다. 여야 원내대표는 신속하게 협의해야 한다는 조 의장의 요구에 공감대를 보였으나 구체적인 진전은 없었던 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Rep. Jang blocked at entrance after visiting Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency (광주경찰청 갔다가 입구서 제지 당한 張)
item.description:
Rep. Jang blocked at entrance after visiting Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency (광주경찰청 갔다가 입구서 제지 당한 張)

People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk canceled a scheduled meeting with new Prime Minister Han Duck-soo at the National Assembly on the 9th and instead visited the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency. This was to protest suspicions of inadequate investigation and cover-up by the police regarding the "murder case of a high school girl in Jeonnam and Gwangju." However, the police blocked his entry into the building, citing the absence of the police chief, and after a 35-minute standoff, the meeting fell through. The PPP announced it would push for a parliamentary hearing on the police's alleged cover-up. <<> Representative Jang was scheduled to meet with new Prime Minister Han at the National Assembly at 2 p.m. that day. However, about five hours before the meeting, he notified the press that the meeting was postponed and announced a schedule to meet with the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Commissioner. Subsequently, Representative Jang, along with Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook, party leader’s chief of staff Park Jun-tae, and lawmakers Kim Jang-kyum and Seo Cheon-ho, headed to the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency. A party official said, "Considering the urgency of the issue, the meeting with the prime minister was postponed." <<> However, upon arriving at the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency, Representative Jang and his group were stopped at the entrance and unable to enter. The Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency cited reasons such as "the commissioner is absent due to external schedule" and "security reasons" to block entry. A police official stated, "We received notification in the morning that the PPP would visit unilaterally, but there was no appointment for a meeting." The agency claimed the police commissioner was out conducting on-site inspections in preparation for heavy rain. <<> Speaking to reporters, Representative Jang said, "This shows a lack of will and intention to protect the lives and safety of the people, and treating citizens this way has led to such crimes," adding, "It manifests as an attempt to destroy evidence, reduce investigations, and cover up cases, treating the suspect as one of their own." He further criticized the government and the Democratic Party of Korea's push to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority, stating, "If the police hold all investigative powers, the damage will solely fall on the people, and more absurd incidents like this will occur," warning that, "Ultimately, the lives and safety of the people of South Korea will not be protected." <<> The father of Jang Yun-ki, the suspect in the murder case of a high school girl in Jeonnam and Gwangju, is a current police officer. It has shocked the public that he had multiple phone calls with the investigation team handling his son's case and is suspected of discarding or hiding key evidence. These suspicions of inadequate police investigation and collusion came to light during the prosecution's supplementary investigation, and the Democratic Party is now pushing for the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. <<> Representative Jang is considering attending rallies to protect voting rights across the country, starting with Incheon the previous day, followed by Busan, Gwangju, and Daegu. Having consistently attended rallies at the Olympic Park in Jamsil, Songpa-gu, Seoul, he plans to travel nationwide to meet with young people. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 9일 한성숙 신임 국무총리 국회 면담 일정을 취소하고 광주경찰청을 찾았다. ‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’과 관련해 경찰의 부실 수사, 은폐 의혹에 대해 항의하기 위해서다. 하지만 경찰이 청장이 없다는 이유로 청사 진입을 막았고, 35분간 실랑이를 벌인 끝에 면담이 불발됐다. 국민의힘은 경찰의 수사 은폐에 대해 국회 청문회를 추진하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "How Embarrassing Is the Approval Rating Drop?" | Jung Cheong-rae: "Party Members Dislike Blaming Others" (김민석 “지지율 하락, 얼마나 망신인가” 정청래 “당원은 남 탓 싫어해”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "How Embarrassing Is the Approval Rating Drop?" | Jung Cheong-rae: "Party Members Dislike Blaming Others" (김민석 “지지율 하락, 얼마나 망신인가” 정청래 “당원은 남 탓 싫어해”)

Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister who has entered the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership race, targeted former leader Jung Cheong-rae on the 9th, saying, "(The Democratic Party) is trailing (the People Power Party) in approval ratings, so what's the point of just hurling insults at them as an 'insurrectionist force'?" Jung retorted, "What party members hate most is blaming others and engaging in negativity." The debate continued over the party leadership election method, which is effectively determined by a preferential voting system. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 9일 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥해 “(민주당이 국민의힘에) 지지율에서 밀리는데 (국민의힘을) ‘내란 세력’이라고 욕만 하면 뭐 하나”라고 말했다. 정 전 대표는 “당원들이 제일 싫어하는 것은 남 탓하고 ‘네거티브’ 하는 것”이라며 맞받았다. 사실상 선호투표로 결정된 당대표 선거 선출 방식을 둘러싼 공방도 계속됐다.)

At a meeting with party members in Suncheon-gap, South Jeolla Province, earlier that day, Kim brought up the decline in the Democratic Party's approval ratings at the tail end of Jung's tenure, saying, "How embarrassing is that?" Regarding the results of local elections, including the failed attempt to recapture the Seoul mayoral seat, he said, "It should have been tied to the president's approval rating, but the outcome dropped like a steep waterfall," adding, "The party's image accumulated over a year (under Jung's leadership) manifested in those results." He continued, "I won't be a party leader who only criticizes the insurrectionist force, but one who defeats it," vowing, "I'll widen the approval rating gap within three months." <<> In response, Jung posted on Facebook that afternoon, saying, "What party members hate most is blaming others," and declared, "I won't engage in negativity. I won't badmouth or insult my opponent. If I'm hit, I'll take it." However, he added, "Occasionally, I'll exercise self-defense." As the party leadership race turned into a four-way contest, Jung remarked, "If you fight 2-to-1 or 3-to-1, you get thoroughly beaten. It hurts a lot." But the pro-Moon faction reacted to Jung's comments, saying, "Look back at the time when you wielded party power," and "I was in a lot of pain back then too." <<> Meanwhile, the Democratic Party's National Convention Preparation Committee convened a plenary meeting that day and concluded that the preferential voting system, which the pro-Chung faction opposes, does not violate the party's constitution and rules. Previously, the pro-Chung faction argued that preferential voting violates party rules and that a runoff between the top two candidates should be held if no candidate receives a majority. However, the committee explained that preferential voting is a type of runoff. The pro-Moon faction stated, "Leader Jung initially agreed to it, but when he calculated the votes and found it disadvantageous, he started raising objections belatedly." The party leadership is expected to finalize a decision at a supreme council meeting on the 10th. <<> This issue is also fueling growing conflict between the pro-Moon and pro-Chung factions. Speaking to reporters that day, Kim said, "If they keep quibbling over the rules, it's a classic case of collective 'self-interested politics.'" Former leader Song Young-gil also commented, "If this is changed, they won't fully accept the result, and that's unacceptable." Conversely, pro-Chung Supreme Council member Park Kyu-hwan asked, "Why push for preferential voting even if it means violating the party constitution and rules?" (김 전 총리는 이날 오전 전남 순천갑 당원들과의 간담회에서 정 전 대표 재임기 막바지에 벌어진 민주당 지지율 하락을 거론하면서 “얼마나 망신인가”라고 했다. 서울시장 탈환 실패 등 지방선거 결과에 대해서도 “대통령 지지도와 연결돼야 하는데, 결과는 낙차가 큰 폭포가 뚝 떨어지듯 떨어졌다”며 “(정 전 대표 시절) 1년간 쌓인 당의 모습이 결과로 나온 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “내란 세력 비판만 하는 당대표가 아닌, 내란 세력을 이기는 당대표가 되겠다”며 “3개월 안에 지지율 격차를 확 벌리겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: "AI is Now a Core Competency for Public Service" – PM’s Drive Spurs Prime Minister’s Office to Launch ‘AI Morning Lecture’ (“이제 AI가 공직사회 기본 역량” 韓총리 드라이브에 총리실 ‘AI 아침 강연’까지)
item.description:
"AI is Now a Core Competency for Public Service" – PM’s Drive Spurs Prime Minister’s Office to Launch ‘AI Morning Lecture’ (“이제 AI가 공직사회 기본 역량” 韓총리 드라이브에 총리실 ‘AI 아침 강연’까지)

The Prime Minister’s Office has launched an ‘AI Morning Lecture’ series for its staff, marking the inauguration of Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, who emphasizes the transition to an ‘AI-driven government.’ (국무총리실이 ‘AI(인공지능) 활용 정부’로의 전환을 강조하는 한성숙 총리의 취임을 계기로 총리실 직원들을 대상으로 ‘AI 아침 강연’을 시작했다.)

On the 10th, at 8 AM in the Seoul Government Complex, the Prime Minister’s Office invited Lee Seung-hyun, CEO of Alphacap Lab and author of ‘AI National Wealth,’ to deliver a lecture on the theme of ‘Understanding the AI Era and Strategies for Rapid Spread of Public AX (AI Transformation).’ Prime Minister Han, along with key officials and staff including Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Office for Government Policy Coordination head Yun Chang-ryeol, attended. (총리실은 10일 오전 8시 정부서울청사에서 ‘AI 국부론’의 저자인 이승현 알파카랩 대표를 불러 ‘AI 시대 이해 및 공공 AX(인공지능 전환) 속도감 있는 확산 전략’을 주제로 강연을 들었다. 한 총리와 윤창렬 국무조정실장 등 총리실 주요 간부와 직원들이 참석했다.)

CEO Lee emphasized, "We have entered an era where AI is not just a simple work tool but an ‘AI Agent’ that collaborates with humans," adding, "For the public sector to lead the AI transformation, the Prime Minister’s Office must present a data roadmap through inter-ministerial coordination and proactively overhaul infrastructure and systems." (이 대표는 “AI가 단순한 업무 도구를 넘어 사람과 함께 일하는 ‘AI 에이전트’ 시대로 진입했다”며 “공공 부문이 AI 대전환을 선도해 나가기 위해서는 총리실이 부처 간 조정을 통해 데이터 로드맵을 제시하고, 선제적으로 인프라와 제도를 정비해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

During the subsequent Q&A session, staff raised practical questions such as, "What role should the Prime Minister’s Office play when AI policies are being implemented across multiple ministries?" and "How should policy coordination change using AI?" (이어진 질의응답 시간에는 ‘AI 정책이 여러 부처에 걸쳐 추진되는 상황에서 총리실이 어떤 역할을 해야 하는지’ ‘AI를 활용한 정책 조정은 어떻게 달라져야 하는지’ 등에 관한 실무자들의 질문이 이어졌다.)

Prime Minister Han stressed, "AI innovation is no longer an option but a fundamental competency of the public service," and "The Prime Minister’s Office must first understand and actively utilize AI to create a new model of inter-ministerial collaboration and policy coordination." She also urged, "Employees should actively use AI as a daily work partner to create administrative innovation that citizens can truly feel." (한 총리는 “AI 혁신은 더 이상 선택이 아닌 공직 사회의 기본 역량”이라며 “총리실이 먼저 AI를 이해하고 적극 활용해 부처 간 협업과 정책 조정의 새로운 모델을 만들어 나가야 한다”고 강조했다. 그러면서 “직원들도 AI를 일상적인 업무 파트너로 적극 활용해 국민이 체감할 수 있는 행정 혁신을 만들어 달라”고 당부했다.)

The Prime Minister’s Office explained that this lecture was "prepared as part of an effort to elevate the office into an organization equipped with AI capabilities, in line with Han Sung-sook’s inauguration as the ‘AI Innovation Prime Minister.’" The office stated, "Through these lectures, we aim to enhance employees’ understanding of AI change trends and public AX, and to substantively support the pursuit of ‘AI Transformation,’ a key agenda of Prime Minister Han. We plan to hold ongoing lectures focusing on various topics such as public AX, data, and bio." (총리실은 이번 강연을 “한성숙 ‘AI 혁신 총리’ 취임을 계기로 총리실이 AI 역량을 갖춘 조직으로 발돋움하기 위한 일환으로 준비했다”고 설명했다. 총리실은 “강연을 통해 직원들의 AI 변화 양상과 공공 AX에 대한 이해도를 높이고, 한 총리의 핵심 어젠다인 ‘AI 대전환’ 추진을 내실 있게 뒷받침해 나갈 계획”이라며 “공공 AX, 데이터, 바이오 등 다양한 주제를 중심으로 강연을 지속적으로 개최할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han, a former IT journalist and internet company executive, has positioned herself as a prime minister leading innovation in both the public and private sectors based on AI technology. In her inaugural address on the 2nd, she declared, "I will ensure that South Koreans can utilize AI better than anyone else in the world," pledging to build an AI ecosystem and ‘rationalize’ regulations that hinder it. The government also vowed to become the ‘government that best utilizes AI,’ promising full-scale adoption of AI systems for work tasks and the expansion of the connection and openness of government-held data. (IT 전문 기자와 인터넷 기업 간부 출신인 한 총리는 AI 기술을 바탕으로 공공과 민간 부문 혁신을 이끄는 총리가 되겠다고 자임하고 있다. 한 총리는 지난 2일 취임사에서 “대한민국 국민이 세계에서 AI를 가장 잘 활용할 수 있도록 하겠다”며, AI 생태계를 구축하고 이를 가로막는 규제는 ‘합리화’하겠다고 했다. 정부도 ‘AI를 가장 잘 활용하는 정부’로 만들겠다며 업무용 AI 시스템 전면 도입, 정부가 보유한 데이터의 연결과 개방 확대를 약속했다.)

On the 9th, during her first national policy coordination meeting as prime minister, she adopted the ‘Strategy for Realizing an AI Democratic Government.’ The plan includes making administrative information AI-friendly and open, reducing unnecessary labor for public officials through AI, and leveraging AI for communication between citizens and public officials as well as for public services. (지난 9일에는 총리 취임 후 처음으로 주재한 국가 정책 조정 회의에서 ‘AI민주정부 실현 전략’을 채택했다. 행정 정보를 AI 친화적으로 개방하고, AI를 활용해 공직자의 불필요한 노동을 줄이며, 국민과 공직자의 소통과 대국민 서비스에도 AI를 활용하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "Reform Party Must Reveal When They Knew Jeong Yi-han's 'Self-Staged' Incident" Lee Jun-seok: "Completely Unaware During Election Period" (한동훈 “개혁신당, 정이한 ‘자작극’ 인지 시점 밝혀야” 이준석 “선거 기간 중 전혀 몰랐다”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "Reform Party Must Reveal When They Knew Jeong Yi-han's 'Self-Staged' Incident" Lee Jun-seok: "Completely Unaware During Election Period" (한동훈 “개혁신당, 정이한 ‘자작극’ 인지 시점 밝혀야” 이준석 “선거 기간 중 전혀 몰랐다”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated on the 10th, in response to media reports that police were aware of Reform Party candidate Jeong Yi-han's "self-staged terrorist" incident before the June 3 by-elections, that "the police and the Reform Party must clarify when they knew that this was a self-staged act." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 10일 경찰이 개혁신당 정이한 후보의 ‘테러 자작극’을 6·3 지방선거 이전에 인지했다는 언론 보도와 관련해 “경찰과 개혁신당은 ‘자작극이라는 사실’을 언제 알았는지 밝혀야 한다”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post on the same day, lawmaker Han said, "Candidate Jeong received more votes than he would have otherwise due to sympathy over the terrorist attack, and Busan citizens were deceived into voting, having their voting rights stolen." He added, "If it had been known before the election that the terrorist act was self-staged, far fewer Busan citizens would have voted for Candidate Jeong, and the (Busan mayoral) election results could have changed." He continued, "If the police knew before the election that it was a self-staged act, they should have disclosed that fact, and the Reform Party should have confessed and withdrawn its candidate." (한 의원은 이날 페이스북 글에서 “정 후보는 테러 동정심으로 자신이 받을 수 있었던 표보다 더 득표했고, 부산 시민들은 속아서 투표해 투표권을 강탈당했다”며 “테러가 자작극이라는 사실을 선거 전에 알았다면 정 후보에게 투표할 부산시민은 훨씬 적었을 것이고, (부산시장) 선거 결과가 바뀌었을 수도 있다”고 했다. 이어 “경찰이 자작극이라는 사실을 선거 전에 알았다면 그 사실을 알렸어야 했고, 개혁신당은 그 사실을 고백하고 후보를 사퇴시켰어야 했다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Han remarked, "I pointed out in an interview right after the June election that if the police had known it was a self-staged act but did not investigate or disclose it, that would constitute police interference in the election." He added, "If they knew before the election, the police and the Reform Party must take responsibility for infringing on the voting rights of Busan citizens." (한 의원은 “지난 6월 선거 직후 인터뷰에서 경찰이 자작극이라는 사실을 파악하고도 수사·공개하지 않았다면 경찰의 선거개입이라고 지적했었다”며 “선거 전에 알았다면 경찰과 개혁신당은 부산시민의 참정권을 침해한 책임을 져야 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok told reporters on the same day, "I had no idea at all (about Candidate Jeong's crime during the election period)," and asked, "How could such a person have told us (that he was a suspect)? Also, didn't the police say they didn't officially notify us?" Leader Lee stated, "Some politicians may raise suspicions, but we were unable to know, and we did not know." (이에 대해 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(선거 기간 정 후보의 범행을) 전혀 몰랐다”며 “그런 사람이 저희에게 (피의자 신분임을) 얘기해줬을리도 만무하고, 경찰도 공식적으로 저희에게 통보 안 했다고 하지 않느냐”고 했다. 이 대표는 “일부 정치인이 의혹을 제기할 수는 있지만, 저희는 인지할 수도 없었고 인지하지 않았다”고 했다.)

item.title: No One Admits to Providing It… How Was ‘Kim Min-seok’s CCTV’ Obtained? (줬다는 사람이 없다… ‘김민석 CCTV’ 어떻게 입수했나)
item.description:
No One Admits to Providing It… How Was ‘Kim Min-seok’s CCTV’ Obtained? (줬다는 사람이 없다… ‘김민석 CCTV’ 어떻게 입수했나)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, as pro-Chung [Sae-kyun] factions attacked former lawmaker Kim Min-seok for his absence from the vote on the December 3 martial law lifting, pro-opposition YouTuber Kim Eo-jun recently released security camera footage showing Kim Min-seok running around inside and outside the National Assembly at the time. The claim is that he narrowly missed the vote by a split second. However, since then, political circles have been buzzing with speculation about how Kim Eo-jun obtained the footage. The security camera footage is only kept by the National Assembly Secretariat, which has largely restricted its release due to privacy protection and ongoing investigations and trials related to the insurrection. <<> Kim Min-seok, a leadership contender, appeared on Kim Eo-jun’s YouTube channel on the 8th. He was under fire from pro-Chung Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, who criticized him for failing to participate in the vote on the day of the martial law. Previously, Kim Min-seok had responded to such attacks by saying, “I fell asleep after taking cold medicine, and headed to the National Assembly immediately after waking up.” On the day, Kim Eo-jun defended Kim Min-seok, stating, “At the time of the vote, he had already climbed over the Assembly fence and was inside,” to which Kim Min-seok added, “I was just one second late.” <<> Then, Kim Eo-jun said, “So, upon hearing that, we actually obtained the CCTV footage,” and played the video. It showed Kim Min-seok climbing over the National Assembly fence. Kim Min-seok appeared surprised, saying, “That would only be available from the National Assembly,” and Kim Eo-jun replied, “Yes, we obtained it with great difficulty.” The subsequent footage showed Kim Min-seok running inside the main building of the National Assembly right before the vote. Kim Eo-jun then said to Supreme Council member Lee, who had raised the suspicion, “He woke up late and barely missed attending,” and added, “You should apologize cleanly.” <<> While the suspicions around Kim Min-seok seemed somewhat resolved, attention shifted to how the security camera footage was obtained. An official from the National Assembly Secretariat explained, “We can only provide the footage if the person appearing in it makes a direct request,” adding, “A third party receiving the footage through the Assembly could violate the Personal Information Protection Act.” This implies that Kim Eo-jun did not obtain it directly. Indeed, according to Articles 4 and 35 of the Personal Information Protection Act, individuals can request access to security camera footage in which they appear. However, Kim Min-seok, appearing on Kim Eo-jun’s YouTube channel, reacted as if seeing the footage for the first time. <<> Notably, while the source of the footage is clearly the National Assembly Secretariat, opinions were divided on who gave it to whom and how it ended up with Kim Eo-jun. A source from the office of current National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik said, “I understand it came from the Secretariat during the previous Speaker’s term,” while a source from the office of former Speaker Park Byeong-seug, who served as acting Speaker, stated, “That’s completely unlikely.” However, both camp sources confirmed, “This footage can only be obtained by the person shown in it.” An Assembly official commented, “The volume of security camera footage from inside and outside the National Assembly during the martial law period is enormous. Even the investigating agencies and media were only given limited access to this footage. The release of specific footage seems problematic, which is why it inevitably ends up in a game of truths.” <<> Kim Eo-jun, who supported former representative Jeong Cheong-rae in last year’s leadership election, playing the security camera footage and defending Kim Min-seok has also drawn “unexpected” reactions within the ruling party. During the recent YouTube broadcast, Kim Min-seok criticized Jeong Cheong-rae in front of Kim Eo-jun, using words like “overambitious,” but Kim Eo-jun did not push back strongly. Kim Eo-jun once had a public spat with Kim Min-seok. When Kim Eo-jun’s pollster “Kkot” listed Kim Min-seok as a candidate for Seoul Mayor, prompting Kim Min-seok’s side to express “regret,” Kim Eo-jun showed displeasure, saying, “I’ll handle it my way.” Additionally, Kim Eo-jun once claimed that President Lee Jae-myung was “grooming Kim Min-seok as the next candidate,” which Kim Min-seok dismissed as “wuxia fiction.” A key ruling party source said, “Some supporters even say Kim Eo-jun has abandoned former representative Jeong Cheong-rae, but isn’t it just both Kim Min-seok and Kim Eo-jun joining hands out of mutual need?” (더불어민주당 당대표 선거를 앞두고 친청계가 김민석 전 총리의 12·3 계엄 해제 표결 불참을 공격하자, 최근 친여 유튜버 김어준씨가 당시 국회 안팎을 뛰어다니는 김 전 총리의 모습이 담긴 보안카메라 영상을 공개했다. 간발의 차로 늦어서 표결에 참여하지 못했다는 주장이다. 하지만 이후 정치권에선 김씨가 어떻게 이 영상을 구했는지를 놓고 설왕설래가 이어지고 있다. 보안카메라 영상은 국회 사무처만 보관하고 있는 것인데 그동안 개인정보 보호와 내란 관련 수사·재판 진행을 이유로 공개를 극히 일부로 제한해왔기 때문이다.)

item.title: At Supreme Council, Pro-Myeong and Pro-Cheong Clash Over Preferential Voting… "Re-discuss Tonight" (與 최고위서 친명·친청 선호투표제 설전...“밤에 재논의”)
item.description:
At Supreme Council, Pro-Myeong and Pro-Cheong Clash Over Preferential Voting… "Re-discuss Tonight" (與 최고위서 친명·친청 선호투표제 설전...“밤에 재논의”)

The Democratic Party of Korea discussed whether to introduce a preferential voting system for the party leadership election at the August 17 National Convention during a Supreme Council meeting but failed to reach a conclusion. The pro-Myeong (pro-Lee Jae-myung) faction, which demands the introduction of the preferential voting system, and the opposing pro-Cheong (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) faction engaged in a heated verbal exchange during the open session. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 도입할지 여부를 최고위원회의에서 논의했으나 결론을 내리지 못했다. 선호투표제 도입을 요구하는 친명(친이재명)계와 이에 반대하는 친청(친정청래)계는 공개 회의에서 설전을 벌였다.)

On the morning of the 10th, the Democratic Party held a closed-door Supreme Council meeting to discuss the preferential voting system and the introduction of elected youth supreme council members, but failed to narrow their differences. Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun stated, "Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do said, 'We will reach a conclusion in some form today,'" and added, "We will reconvene the Supreme Council tonight to make a decision." (민주당은 10일 오전 비공개 최고위원회의를 열고 선호투표제, 선출직 청년최고위원 도입 여부를 논의했지만, 이견을 좁히지 못했다. 강준현 수석대변인은 “한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 ‘오늘 어떤 형태로든 결론을 내겠다’고 했다”면서 “오늘 밤 다시 최고위를 열어 결정하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The preferential voting system is a method where voters list candidates in order of preference as 1st, 2nd, and 3rd on the ballot. If no candidate receives a majority, the votes of the lowest-ranked candidate are redistributed to their next preferred candidates. Previously, the party's National Convention Preparation Committee decided to adopt this system for the upcoming convention, but it has yet to be approved by the Supreme Council due to opposition from the pro-Cheong faction. While pro-Myeong figures like former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil welcome the preferential voting system, former leader Jung Cheong-rae opposes it, calling it a "violation of the party constitution and rules." (선호투표제는 유권자가 선호도에 따라 투표용지에 1·2·3 순위 후보를 적고, 과반 득표자가 없으면 최하위 득표자의 차순위 후보를 합산하는 방식이다. 앞서 민주당 ‘전당대회준비위원회(전준위)’는 이번 전당대회에 선호투표제를 도입하기로 결정했지만, 친청계 반발로 최고위 의결을 받지 못하고 있다. 친명계인 김민석 전 국무총리와 송영길 의원은 선호투표제를 환영한다는 입장인 반면, 정청래 전 대표는 “당헌·당규 위반”이라며 반대하고 있다.)

During the Supreme Council meeting that day, the pro-Myeong and pro-Cheong factions exchanged sharp remarks. Pro-Myeong Supreme Council member Hwang Myung-sun said, "Everyone agreed to this a year ago, and former leader Lee Jae-myung introduced this system after deep consideration. Now, they're shaking it because it disadvantages a specific candidate. This is the start of turning the party into a private organization by flipping the rules based on self-interest, and it is absolutely unacceptable." Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, who is close to former Prime Minister Kim, also stated, "The preferential voting system does not violate the party constitution or rules. The party rules clearly state that the floor leader election can be conducted using preferential voting or other methods. This was already approved by the Party Affairs Committee last year as the method for electing the party leader." Kang shook the meeting minutes from last year's Party Affairs Committee and asked, "Why has a norm that caused no problems for a year suddenly become a violation of the party constitution and rules?" (이날 최고위에서도 친명계와 친청계는 날 선 말을 주고받았다. 친명계 황명선 최고위원은 “1년 전 모두가 찬성했고 이재명 당시 대표께서 고심 끝에 도입한 이 제도(선호투표제)를 이제 와서 특정 후보에게 불리하다는 이유로 흔들고 있다”면서 “당의 룰을 유불리에 따라 뒤집으려는 사당화의 시작으로 결코 용납될 수 없다”고 했다. 김 전 총리와 가까운 강득구 최고위원도 “선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반이 아니다”라면서 “원내대표 선거를 선호투표 등 방법으로 실시할 수 있다고 당규에 분명히 명시돼 있다. 지난해 당무위에서 당대표 선출 방식으로 이미 의결된 바 있다”고도 했다. 강 최고위원은 당시 당무위 회의록을 흔들며 “1년 동안 아무 문제가 없던 규범이 갑자기 당헌·당규 위반이 되는 이유가 무엇이냐”고도 했다.)

In contrast, pro-Cheong Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon said, "The party constitution is our party's constitution," and argued, "To introduce a preferential voting system that clearly violates the party constitution and rules, we must first amend the party constitution and rules, just as President Lee Jae-myung did." Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok also remarked, "I am curious about the ulterior motive behind insisting on preserving a system with identified flaws as if it were a golden rule." (반면 친청계 이성윤 최고위원은 “당헌은 우리 당의 헌법”이라면서 “명백하게 당헌·당규에 위반되는 선호 투표제를 도입하려면 이재명 대통령이 하셨던 것처럼 당헌·당규를 개정해야 한다”고 했다. 문정복 최고위원도 “오류가 발견된 제도를 금과옥조처럼 지키려고 하는 저의가 궁금하다”고 했다.)

Another pro-Cheong member, Supreme Council member Park Gyu-hwan, stated, "The behavior of covertly undermining the party constitution to pursue private interests must end. Only those who lack the ability to innovate the party or the will to carry on its legacy and traditions would divide party members and sow hatred for their own petty gains." (역시 친청인 박규환 최고위원은 “음험하게 당헌을 훼손하면서까지 사사로운 이익을 도모하는 행태는 사라져야 한다”면서 “당을 혁신할 실력도, 당의 유산과 전통을 이어갈 의지도 없는 세력만이 알량한 자기 이익을 위해 당원을 편 가르고 혐오를 심는 법”이라고 하기도 했다.)

Meanwhile, pro-Myeong Supreme Council members Kang Deuk-gu and Hwang Myung-sun called for the resignation of pro-Cheong Supreme Council members shortly after the meeting ended, speaking with reporters. They claimed that the pro-Cheong Supreme Council members plan to run as candidates for supreme council member or provincial party chairperson in the next national convention, stating, "It's like a player running the race making the rules when those intending to run discuss election regulations." (한편 친명계인 강득구·황명선 최고위원은 최고위원회의 종료 직후 기자들과 만나 친청계 최고위원들의 사퇴를 요구했다. 두 사람은 친청계 최고위원들이 차기 전당대회에 최고위원 또는 도당위원장 후보로 출마할 예정이라면서, “출마 예정자가 선출 규정을 논의하는 것은 경기 뛰는 선수가 룰을 만드는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Jeom-sik: "Minister of Interior and Safety and Acting Police Commissioner Should Resign Over 'Jang Yun-gi Case'" (정점식 “행안장관·경찰청장 대행, ‘장윤기 사건’ 책임지고 사퇴해야”)
item.description:
Jeong Jeom-sik: "Minister of Interior and Safety and Acting Police Commissioner Should Resign Over 'Jang Yun-gi Case'" (정점식 “행안장관·경찰청장 대행, ‘장윤기 사건’ 책임지고 사퇴해야”)

On the 10th, People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, referencing the Gwangju female high school student murder case and alleged collusion between suspect Jang Yun-gi's incumbent police officer father and the investigative team, stated, "Yoon Ho-jung, Minister of the Interior and Safety, and Yoo Jae-sung, Acting Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency, should take responsibility for this situation and resign." <<> At a party leadership meeting held that morning at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, Floor Leader Jeong said, "The president and the government should not turn a blind eye, using police independence as an excuse, but must take responsibility for bold organizational reform of the police." <<> He added, "Curbing the police's exclusive investigative powers through the prosecution's complementary investigative authority is only natural, and special measures are needed to restore public trust in the police," warning, "If the police fail to reflect and reform in the wake of this incident, trust in the entire police force could collapse, and even their very existence may be threatened." <<> Floor Leader Jeong proposed, "I once again suggest convening a 'ruling party-opposition party-government consultation table' for investigative agency reform, including measures to check the police's complete monopoly of investigative powers." <<> Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong also addressed the case, saying, "Under the guise of prosecution reform, the Democratic Party of Korea is charging ahead without brakes to abolish the prosecution's complementary authority," and noted, "The suspicions of police negligence and cover-up revealed in the investigation of the Gwangju female high school student death case clearly demonstrate the necessity of the prosecution's complementary investigative authority." <<> He added, "The People Power Party will push for a National Assembly hearing to uncover the truth behind the botched investigation of the Gwangju female high school student death case." <<> Furthermore, the People Power Party decided to pursue an amendment to the Criminal Act, limiting the 'family privilege' for serious crimes such as murder, as well as for the concealment of criminals and destruction of evidence related to the duties of investigative agency personnel, in light of this case. <<> Deputy Chief Policy Coordinator Kim Mi-ae stated, "The Jang Yun-gi case is shocking not only for the crime itself but also for the suspicions of concealment and evidence destruction by the suspect's incumbent police officer father and fellow officers after the crime," and emphasized, "The People Power Party will push to amend the Criminal Act to restrict the family privilege and impose heavier penalties for serious crimes like murder, rape, and robbery, as well as for investigative officials' job-related concealment of criminals and destruction of evidence." <<> After the meeting, Senior Spokesperson for the floor leadership Choi Su-jin told reporters, "The People Power Party has prepared an alternative bill regarding the Democratic Party's push to abolish the complementary investigative authority, and we plan to advance it as party policy soon." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 10일 광주 여고생 피살 사건과 관련, 피의자 장윤기의 현직 경찰 아버지와 수사팀의 유착 의혹을 거론하며 “윤호중 행정안전부 장관과 유재성 경찰청장 직무대행은 이번 사태 책임을 지고 사퇴해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not acts harmful to the party” (장동혁 “한동훈, 해당행위 아닌 범죄행위로 제명당한 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: “Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not acts harmful to the party” (장동혁 “한동훈, 해당행위 아닌 범죄행위로 제명당한 것”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 10th, “People keep saying we should embrace them and not engage in subtractive politics, but those who point guns at their own side are a minus,” reiterating his resolve to establish party discipline through disciplinary measures. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 10일 “계속해서 ‘끌어안아야 된다’ ‘뺄셈 정치 하지 마라’고 하는데 우리 편을 향해 총을 쏘는 사람은 마이너스”라며 징계를 통한 당 기강 확립 의지를 재차 드러냈다.)

Appearing on Newdaily’s YouTube channel that day, Representative Jang said, “Calling for the removal of those who aim guns at us is being unconditionally labeled as subtractive politics, but it’s actually telling us not to take such (disciplinary) action that constitutes subtractive politics.” (장 대표는 이날 뉴데일리 유튜브에 출연해 “우리한테 총부리를 겨누는 사람을 정리를 해야 된다고 하는 것을 무조건 뺄셈 정치라고 하는데 그런 거(징계) 하지 말라고 이야기하는 게 뺄셈 정치”라며 이처럼 말했다.)

He remarked, “A ragtag army cannot win a war.” He added, “What’s more important is whether we can unite as a single force and fight together. If we have 100 people, but 20 of them are shooting at their own side, I believe those 20 are worse than having none at all.” (그는 “오합지졸 같은 병사로는 전쟁에서 승리할 수 없다”고 말했다. 이어 “단일 대오로 뭉쳐 하나로 힘을 모아서 싸울 수 있는 그런 조직이냐가 더 중요하다”며 “100명이 있지만 20명이 자기 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 사람이 있다면 저는 그 20명은 없는 것만 못하다는 생각을 하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding candidates who left the party to run as independents, Representative Jang said, “They can never be part of our party again.” He explained, “In the course of this local election, there have been many cases where candidates left the party, ran as independents, won, and our party’s candidate lost. At the time, many lawmakers demanded that we must send a strong message permanently banning those who left for independent runs from ever rejoining. Only then would they stop aiding these individuals and instead support our party’s candidates.” (장 대표는 탈당해 무소속으로 출마한 후보에 대해서는 “영원히 우리 당의 같은 일원이 될 수 없다”고 했다. 그는 “이번 지방선거 과정에서 탈당해서 무소속으로 출마해 그 후보가 당선되고 우리 당 후보가 떨어진 경우들이 많이 있다”며 “당시 많은 의원님들이 ‘지금 탈당해서 무소속 출마한 사람들에 대해서 영원히 복당을 금지한다고 강하게 메시지를 내야만 한다. 그래야 이 사람들을 돕지 않고 우리 당 후보를 돕게 된다’고 요구했었다”고 말했다.)

He thus hinted at banning independents from rejoining the party. He stated, “When people leave the party and run as independents, we’ve threatened strong discipline and expulsion, but in the end, we’ve allowed them back by saying, ‘We must embrace everyone’ and ‘We need unity,’ so no one fears the consequences. I don’t think we should operate the party with the mindset that we can just accept them back and, if we lack numbers, make them our candidates again.” Previously, Representative Jang had appointed former Supreme Council member Jang Ye-chan, who ran as an independent after having his nomination revoked in the 2024 general election, as deputy director of the Yeouido Research Institute late last year. (그러면서 무소속 출마한 인사에 대해서는 복당 금지를 시사했다. 그는 “탈당 후 무소속 출마하는 경우 강하게 징계하고 제명할 것처럼 하다가 결국 ‘우리가 다 끌어안아야 한다’ ‘통합해야 한다’고 해서 복당해 주고 그렇게 해 왔기 때문에 아무도 두려워하지 않는다”며 “(탈당 후 출마했던 사람들을) 그냥 받아주고 사람 없으면 결국 또 우리 후보로 만들면 된다는 생각을 가지고 당을 운영해서는 저는 안 된다고 생각한다”고 했다. 앞서 장 대표는 2024년 총선 당시 공천이 취소돼 무소속으로 출마했던 장예찬 전 최고위원을 작년 말 여의도연구원 부원장직에 임명했었다.)

However, he drew a line, saying his remarks about a “permanent ban on rejoining” were not aimed at independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon. Representative Jang had previously stated at a closed-door Supreme Council meeting on the 6th, “For serious acts harmful to the party, we should revise the party constitution and rules to permanently ban those individuals from rejoining.” (다만 그는 자신의 ‘영구 복당 금지’ 발언이 무소속 한동훈 의원을 겨냥한 것은 아니라고 선을 그었다. 앞서 장 대표는 지난 6일 당 비공개 최고위원회의에서 “심각한 해당 행위에 대해선 당헌·당규를 개정해서라도 복당을 영구 금지해야 한다”고 발언했었다.)

When asked if this was targeting Han, Representative Jang said, “That’s jumping too far ahead,” adding, “Lawmaker Han was expelled for criminal acts, not for acts harmful to the party.” He further noted, “The ‘party member bulletin board’ issue is a criminal act, not related to a ‘permanent ban on rejoining for those who committed acts harmful to the party.’” (장 대표는 한 의원을 겨냥한 것이냐는 질문에 “너무 앞서 나간 것”이라며 “한 의원은 범죄 행위로 제명을 당한 것이지 해당(害黨) 행위로 제명을 당한 것이 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “‘당원 게시판’ 문제는 범죄 행위지 ‘해당 행위자 복당 영구 금지’에 해당하지 않는다”고 했다.)

Regarding the ballot shortage incident and the reform of the National Election Commission (NEC), he said, “South Korea’s NEC is hopeless; only a special counsel is the answer.” He added, “When ballot boxes were moved to Olympic Park, they were moved by police without NEC officials present, contaminating them. I consider them not ballot boxes but ‘trash bins’ or ‘garbage cans’ filled with unusable ballots. I believe a complete re-election is necessary.” (그는 투표용지 부족 사태와 중앙선거관리위원회 개혁 문제와 관련해서는 “대한민국 선관위는 노답이다, 특검만이 답이다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “올림픽공원에 투표함 옮길 때 선관위원 없이 경찰이 옮겼기 때문에 오염된 투표함”이라며 “투표함이 아니라 못 쓰는 투표용지가 들어간 ‘쓰레기함’, ‘쓰레기통’이라고 생각한다. 전면 재선거를 해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)
item.description:
Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)

The government is pushing forward with a plan to abolish the mandatory reporting requirement when South Korean citizens come into contact with members of the pro-Pyongyang General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chosen Soren). (정부가 우리 국민이 재일본조선인총연합회(조총련) 인사와 접촉할 때 신고의무를 폐지하는 방안을 추진한다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification on the 10th, the ministry plans to cooperate with the National Assembly to ensure that a revision to the "Act on Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation" (Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act), which deletes the clause treating Chosen Soren as North Korean residents, can be discussed during this year's regular parliamentary session. (10일 통일부에 따르면 통일부는 조총련을 북한 주민으로 간주하는 조항을 삭제한 ‘남북교류협력에 관한 법률’ (남북교류협력법) 개정안이 올해 정기국회에서 논의될 수 있도록 국회와 협력할 계획이다.)

Article 30 of the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act stipulates that "members of overseas organizations that act in accordance with North Korea's line are deemed to be residents of North Korea." Founded in 1955, Chosen Soren serves as an external organization of North Korea's Workers' Party, acting as a North Korean representative office in Japan. Legally, Chosen Soren is considered an anti-state organization. Under the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act, anyone wishing to contact Chosen Soren figures must report their contact plan to the government in advance, and if contact occurs unexpectedly, they must report it afterward. (현행 남북교류협력법 제30조는 “북한의 노선에 따라 활동하는 국외단체의 구성원은 북한의 주민으로 본다”고 규정하고 있다. 1955년 창설된 조총련은 북한 노동당의 외곽 조직으로 일본에서 북한대표부 역할을 한다. 조총련은 법적으로는 반국가단체에 해당한다. 현행 남북교류협력법은 조총련 인사와 접촉하려면 정부에 사전에 대북 접촉계획을 신고해야 하고 예상치 못하게 접촉하게 된 경우에는 사후에 신고하도록 되어 있다.)

The government explains that this move reflects changing realities, including the fact that Chosen Soren's size and influence have diminished compared to the past, and that a significant number of its members hold South Korean nationality. Recently, Chosen Soren revised its charter, deleting phrases such as "achieving independent peaceful reunification" and "respecting the June 15 Joint Declaration." Provisions from the previous charter that called for strengthening ties among South, North, and overseas compatriots, including a federation-style unification, were also removed during the revision, and the policy of solidarity and cooperation with the Korean Residents' Union in Japan (Mindan), a pro-Seoul Korean residents' organization, was abandoned. <<> Under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the Ministry of Unification had imposed fines on a civic group led by actor Kwon Hae-hyo (Montang Yeonpil, or "People Together with Joseon Schools") for engaging in "unauthorized contact" without reporting amid its support projects for pro-Pyongyang schools. Director Kim Ji-woon, who produced a documentary on discrimination against ethnic Koreans in Japan, was also investigated on the same charges and received a warning. (정부는 조총련의 규모와 영향력이 과거에 비해 감소했고 조총련 구성원 중에는 대한민국 국적자도 상당하다는 점 등 변화한 현실을 반영하겠다는 설명이다. 최근 조총련은 단체 강령에서 ‘자주적 평화통일 성취’나 ‘6·15 공동선언 존중’ 등의 문구를 삭제하는 등 강령을 개정했다. 과거 강령에 명시됐던 연방제 방식의 통일을 비롯한 남·북·해외 동포 간 유대 강화 조항도 개정 과정에서 모두 사라졌고 재일 한국인 단체인 재일본대한민국민단(민단)과의 연대·협력 방침도 폐기됐다.)
